title: Radar Data Generator
text: Generate radar sensor detections and tracks, 3 inputs, 4 outputs, {Width of target cuboids (m)} sets Width of target cuboids; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Update rate (Hz)} sets the sensor update rate, {Translation [ X, Y, Z ] relative to ego origin (m)} sets the mounting location of radar on platform, {Rotation [Yaw,Pitch,Roll] relative to ego’s frame (deg)} sets the mounting rotation angles of radar, {Enable elevation angle measurements} enables radar to measure target elevation, {Enable range rate measurements} enables radar to measure target range rates, {Add noise to measurements} enables addition of noise to radar sensor, {Enable false reports} enables creating false alarm radar, {Enable occlusion} enables line-of-sight occlusion, {Enable ghosts} enables ghost targets, {Maximum number of target reports} sets the maximum number of detections or tracks, {Target reporting format} sets the format of generated target reports Clustered, {Coordinate system}, {Source of target truth time}, {Enable INS}, {Source of output target report bus name}, {Specify an output target report bus name} sets the name of target report output bus, {Enable radar configuration output}, {Source of output config bus name}, {Specify an output config bus name} sets the name of target report output bus, {Azimuth resolution (deg)} sets the azimuth resolution of radar, {Elevation resolution (deg)} sets the elevation resolution of radar, {Range resolution (m)} sets the range resolution of radar, {Range rate resolution (m/s)} sets the range rate resolution of radar, {Azimuth bias fraction}, {Elevation bias fraction}, {Range bias fraction}, {Range rate bias fraction}, {Total angular field of view [AZ, EL] (deg)} sets the angular field of view of radar, {Range limits [MIN, MAX] (m)} sets the minimum and maximum range of radar, {Range rate limits [MIN, MAX] (m/s)} sets the minimum and maximum range rate of radar, {Detection probability} sets the probability of detecting a target, {False alarm rate} sets the false alarm report, {Reference target range (m)} sets the reference range for given probability, {Reference target RCS (dBsm)} sets the reference radar cross-section for given probability, {Center frequency (Hz)} sets the center frequency of radar, {Filter initialization function name} sets the kalman filter initialization function, {M and N for the M-out-of-N confirmation} sets the threshold for track confirmation, {P and R for the P-out-of-R deletion} sets the threshold for track deletion, {Random number generation} sets the method to specify random number generator seed, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator seed, {Target profiles definition} sets the method to specify target profiles From Scenario Reader, {MATLAB expression for target profiles}, {Unique target identifiers} sets the scenario-defined target identifier, {Target classification identifiers} sets the user-defined classification identifier, {Length of target cuboids (m)}, {Height of heights cuboids (m)} sets the height of actor cuboids, {Rotational center of target cuboids (m)} sets the rotational center of target cuboids and {Target signatures}. Values come from the instance.
